Generators, as their name suggests, are entities that generate ''something'' (forest, road, wall, river, powerlines etc).

They are based on Shapes, polylines/splines, closed or not depending on the generator. As of {{armaR}} 1.0.0, a generator '''must''' be a shape's direct child.

{{Feature|informative|
* For information on generator usage, see {{GameCategory|armaR|Modding|Official Tools|Workbench|World Editor Generators|Tutorials|text= World Editor Generators tutorials}}.
* For information on shapes, see {{Link|Arma Reforger:World Editor: Vector Tool|Vector Tool}}.
}}
